inlines.v: KINDLY, adjective [See Kind, the noun.] Homogeneal; congenial; kindred; of the same nature. This Johnson supposes to be the original sense; but it is also used as a derivative of the adjective, in the sense of 1. Mild; bland; softening; as kindly showers. KINDLY, adverb With good will; with a disposition to make others happy or to oblige; benevolently; favorably. Let the poor be treated kindly Be kindly affectioned one to another, with brotherly love--Romans 12:10. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them. Genesis 1:1.
